name: Fifth Third Preferred Cash/Back Card

apr.notes: 19.24% to 29.24% variable APR on purchases and on balance transfers after any introductory period. Cash advance variable APR 28.74%. Balance transfer fee $5 or 4%, whichever is greater. APRs as of 10/6/2026.

base_rate.description: 2 Rewards Points (2% cash back) for each $1 spent on qualified purchases; each point is worth $0.01.

rewards.redemption_notes: Unlimited cash rewards with no caps and no expiration.

notes: Available exclusively to Fifth Third Preferred Banking clients. The page lists Mastercard perks that apply to World, World Elite or World Legend cards without naming this card's package, so network_tier is none.
